title: The Sunday Read: ‘The Man Who Made Spain the Magic Capital of the World’

sentences.en: One of the most important things that art can do is remind us that the world is not always what it seeMs.
sentences.zh: 艺术能做的最重要的事情之一，就是提醒我们世界并不总是它看起来的那样。

sentences.en: And magic really emphasizes this.
sentences.zh: 而魔术完美地强化了这一点。

sentences.en: Magic is an art form, and it's an art form that shows you something that definitely should not have happened, considering everything you know about the world.
sentences.zh: 魔术是一种艺术形式，它向你展示了一些根据你对世界的了解绝对不应该发生的事情。

sentences.en: And yet, you did see it happen.
sentences.zh: 然而，你确实亲眼看到了它的发生。

sentences.en: I'm Shuja Hader, and I'm a contributor to the New York Times Magazine.
sentences.zh: 我是舒贾·哈德尔，我是《纽约时报杂志》的撰稿人。

sentences.en: So, magic was actually the first interest I ever had as a kid.
sentences.zh: 所以，魔术其实是我小时候产生的第一兴趣。

sentences.en: Lots of kids are into magic, they get magic sets, and so on.
sentences.zh: 很多小孩子都迷恋魔术，他们买魔术道具套装等等。

sentences.en: But I actually won a magic competition when I was 13 years old.
sentences.zh: 但我在13岁时真的赢过一场魔术比赛。

sentences.en: I can still remember the Dewey Decimal Code where you find books on magic at the public library.
sentences.zh: 我依然记得在公共图书馆里能找到魔术书籍的杜威十进分类法代码。

sentences.en: So, are you ready for some magic?
sentences.zh: 那么，你准备好见证奇迹了吗？

sentences.en: I remember seeing this TV special in the 90s called The World's Greatest Magic.
sentences.zh: 我记得在90年代看过一部名为《世界最伟大魔术》的电视特别节目。

sentences.en: We're going to do some things tonight that have never been done before.
sentences.zh: 我们今晚要做一些以前从未做过的事情。

sentences.en: It was full of these big stage illusions with boxes and tigers and so on.
sentences.zh: 里面充满了各种大型舞台幻术，有箱子、老虎等等。

sentences.en: But my favorite parts were the bits of close-up magic, where someone's actually interacting with the magician.
sentences.zh: 但我最喜欢的部分是近景魔术片段，在那里有人真正与魔术师进行互动。

sentences.en: There's a special kind of magic that's performed not on the stage, but in intimate surroundings.
sentences.zh: 有一种特殊的魔术，它不是在舞台上表演，而是在亲密的环绕环境中进行。

sentences.en: It's called close-up magic.
sentences.zh: 这被称为近景魔术。

sentences.en: Someone's asked to pick a card or hold an object, and the trick goes from there.
sentences.zh: 有人被要求抽一张牌或拿一个物体，戏法就从那里开始。

sentences.en: In a way, it's even more amazing because the miracles happen only a few inches away.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，它甚至更加神奇，因为奇迹就在区区几英寸的距离外发生。

sentences.en: It's unique in that it has to take place in person.
sentences.zh: 它的独特之处在于它必须当面进行。

sentences.en: Someone else has to be there.
sentences.zh: 必须有其他人在场。

sentences.en: So it becomes intimate, and it's often for an audience of one or a small group.
sentences.zh: 因此它变得很亲密，而且通常是为一个人或一小群观众表演。

sentences.en: If you're there, it can actually be really moving to be part of the experience.
sentences.zh: 如果你身在现场，成为体验的一部分其实会非常触动人心。

sentences.en: One of the most unforgettable magicians I saw on World's Greatest Magic, I later found out, is widely considered to be the greatest living magician in the world today.
sentences.zh: 我后来发现，我在《世界最伟大魔术》中看到的其中一位最令人难忘的魔术师，被广泛认为是当今世界上最伟大的在世魔术师。

sentences.en: Juan Tameriz.
sentences.zh: 胡安·塔马利斯。

sentences.en: Performing at Cleopatra's Barge in Caesar's Palace, here he is, Juan Tameriz.
sentences.zh: 他在凯撒宫的克利奥帕特拉之驳船上表演，他就是胡安·塔马利斯。

sentences.en: You know how someone might call you Houdini if you impress them with something amazing?
sentences.zh: 你知道当某人用惊艳的魔术打动你时，他们可能会叫你胡迪尼吗？

sentences.en: People in Spain would call you Tameriz.
sentences.zh: 而在西班牙，人们会叫你塔马利斯。

sentences.en: Now I'm going to do a special thing, the most special thing in the world.
sentences.zh: 现在我要做一件特别的事，世界上最特别的事。

sentences.en: For this week's Sunday read, I spent a week in Madrid with Tameriz.
sentences.zh: 为了本周的周日阅读栏目，我在马德里和塔马利斯度过了一周。

sentences.en: He's a man who's so iconic in his home country that he made me think of Kermit the Frog.
sentences.zh: 他在祖国是如此具有标志性，以至于让我想起了青蛙科米.

sentences.en: He's been on public television, he's instantly recognizable, and he has this sort of larger-than-life persona.
sentences.zh: 他曾出现在公共电视台，人们一眼就能认出他，并且他有一种超越常人的个人魅力。

sentences.en: He's now 80 years old, and he told me that he can't remember a time when he wasn't interested in magic.
sentences.zh: 他现在80岁了，他告诉我他记不清自己什么时候对魔术不感兴趣了。

sentences.en: His first TV appearance in the 70s was during a time of cultural renewal in Spain, so he's been this archetype of a magician for the Spanish public for decades.
sentences.zh: 他在70年代的首次电视亮相正值西班牙文化复兴时期，因此几十年来他一直是西班牙公众心目中的魔术师原型。

sentences.en: Magic is so often depicted as kind of an object of ridicule in popular culture.
sentences.zh: 在流行文化中，魔术往往被描绘成一种遭到嘲弄的对象。

sentences.en: Will Arnett's character on Arrested Development comes to mind, but there's a lot of examples.
sentences.zh: 我脑海中浮现出威尔·阿奈特在《发展受阻》中的角色，但这样的例子还有很多。

sentences.en: But I think that people who are deep into magic know that it can actually be incredibly complex, and it's not easy to do.
sentences.zh: 但我认为深入了解魔术的人知道它实际上可以极其复杂，而且并不容易做到。

sentences.en: Tameriz's act is all about the interaction between the magician and the spectator.
sentences.zh: 塔马利斯的表演完全围绕着魔术师和观众之间的互动。

sentences.en: He's not just doing sleight of hand, though he's very good at that.
sentences.zh: 他不仅仅是在玩手法，尽管他在这方面非常厉害。

sentences.en: He's also telling a story, and you become a character in it.
sentences.zh: 他还在讲一个故事，而你成为了其中的一个角色。

sentences.en: You don't just watch something happen, it happens to you.
sentences.zh: 你不仅仅是看着某事发生，它是发生在你身上。

sentences.en: I had a deck of cards with me one night when I was with Tameriz at his apartment, and he finally agreed to perform for me.
sentences.zh: 有一天晚上我和塔马利斯在他的公寓里，我随身带了一副牌，他终于同意为我表演。

sentences.en: And at every stage of every trick he did, I was holding the deck or shuffling the cards or doing the counting.
sentences.zh: 在他表演的每个戏法的每个阶段，我都在拿着牌、洗牌或数数。

sentences.en: It's like he wanted to emphasize that I was the one in control.
sentences.zh: 这就像他想强调掌控一切的人是我一样。

sentences.en: That night, there was one trick in particular that I did think was flat-out impossible.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，有一个戏法我真的觉得完全是不可能的。

sentences.en: But then it happened.
sentences.zh: 但它随后发生了。

sentences.en: It happened right in front of me, literally in my own hands.
sentences.zh: 它就在我眼前发生了，字面意义上就在我自己的手中。

sentences.en: A lot of people have asked me, since this story was published, if I know how Tameriz did some of this stuff.
sentences.zh: 自从这个故事发表以来，很多人问我是否知道塔马利斯是如何做到其中一些事情的。

sentences.en: Hand on heart, I have to tell you.
sentences.zh: 摸着良心，我必须告诉你。

sentences.en: I have no idea.
sentences.zh: 我毫无头绪。

sentences.en: So here's my article.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的文章。

sentences.en: The Man Who Made Spain the Magic Capital of the World.
sentences.zh: 让西班牙成为世界魔术之都的男人。

sentences.en: Read by Anthony Ray Perez.
sentences.zh: 安东尼·雷·佩雷斯朗读。

sentences.en: This was recorded by Autumn.
sentences.zh: 本音频由秋天录制。

sentences.en: To listen to more stories from The New York Times, The New Yorker, Vanity Fair, The Atlantic, and other publications on your smartphone,
sentences.zh: 若想在智能手机上收听更多来自《纽约时报》、《纽约客》、《名利场》、《大西洋月刊》及其他出版物的故事，

sentences.en: download Autumn on the App Store or the Play Store.
sentences.zh: 请在App Store或Play Store下载Autumn。

sentences.en: Visit Autumn, that's A-U-D-M, dot com, for more details.
sentences.zh: 访问Autumn（即A-U-D-M点com）了解更多详情。

sentences.en: Going out to dinner with Juan Tameriz in Madrid is a little like accompanying a cartoon character on a journey to the real world.
sentences.zh: 在马德里与胡安·塔马利斯一起出去吃晚饭，有点像陪着一个卡通人物前往现实世界的旅程。

sentences.en: As I walked with the 80-year-old magician on side streets off the city center's main drag, the Calle Gran Vía, heads turned left and right.
sentences.zh: 当我与这位80岁的魔术师走在市中心主干道格兰大道旁的小街上时，两旁的人都转过头来看着他。

sentences.en: Tameriz has been a professional magician for 52 years,
sentences.zh: 塔马利斯做职业魔术师已经52年了，

sentences.en: and in that time he has managed the singular feat of becoming both a household name in his home country and a living legend in magic everywhere.
sentences.zh: 在这期间，他完成了罕见的壮举：既在祖国成为家喻户晓的名字，又在世界各地成为魔术界的活传奇。

sentences.en: He is referred to by magicians all over the world and waiters all over Madrid as Maestro.
sentences.zh: 世界各地的魔术师和马德里各处的服务员都尊称他为“大师”。

sentences.en: David Blaine has called him the greatest and most influential card magician alive.
sentences.zh: 大卫·布莱恩曾称他为在世最伟大、最具影响力的近景纸牌魔术师。

sentences.en: But in Spain, Tameriz is an icon, less like Blaine or David Copperfield, and more like Kermit the Frog.
sentences.zh: 但在西班牙，塔马利斯是一个偶像，与其说他像布莱恩或大卫·科波菲尔，不如说他更像青蛙科米。

sentences.en: A cluster of young men smoking a joint, heads bowed and pupils dilated, whispered,
sentences.zh: 一群正在抽大麻的年轻男子，低着头，瞳孔放大，低声说道：

sentences.en: Tameriz?
sentences.zh: 是塔马利斯吗？

sentences.en: Uncertain if they could believe their eyes.
sentences.zh: 他们不确定自己是否能相信自己的眼睛。

sentences.en: Imagine getting good and baked in public and seeing Kermit, strolling by.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，在公共场合嗨大发了，然后看到青蛙科米溜达着走过。

sentences.en: One passing woman did a buster Keaton Gray double-take, culminating in an expression of such uninhibited delight that witnessing it seemed to amount to a violation of her privacy.
sentences.zh: 一位路过的女性甚至做出了巴斯特·基顿式的双重惊叹，最后露出了毫无掩饰的喜悦表情，以至于目睹这一幕似乎都构成了对她隐私的侵犯。

sentences.en: Tameriz is used to this.
sentences.zh: 塔马利斯对此已经习以为常。

sentences.en: He will pause mid-sentence to say hello, or pose for a picture, before returning seamlessly to whatever conversation he was engaged in the previous moment.
sentences.zh: 他会在话说到一半时停下来打个招呼，或者摆好姿势拍张照，然后无缝衔接回到他刚才一直在进行的对话中。

sentences.en: A preternatural night owl, he often goes to bed when he sees the sun coming out.
sentences.zh: 作为一个超乎寻常的夜猫子，他经常在看到太阳升起时才去睡觉。

sentences.en: Tameriz is the last to leave any restaurant he dines in, permitting just about every other customer to approach him on their way out.
sentences.zh: 塔马利斯是他用餐的任何餐厅里最后一个离开的人，他允许几乎所有其他顾客在离开的路上走近他。

sentences.en: They always make the same joke, he whispered to me, after a man asked him to make his wife disappear.
sentences.zh: “他们总是开同一个玩笑，”在一个男人请求他让自己的妻子消失之后，他轻声对我说。

sentences.en: But Tameriz reacted as though it were the first time anyone had come up with a notion.
sentences.zh: 但塔马利斯的反应就好像这是第一次有人想出这个主意一样。

sentences.en: I had just attended a performance by Tameriz at a hotel in the trendy Malasaña district, where forty or so local residents came out to see him in the flesh.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚观看过塔马利斯在时尚的马拉萨尼亚区一家酒店里的表演，大约四十名当地居民亲自赶来观看他的演出。

sentences.en: The size of the audience, spectators in the magician's parlance, allowed them to sit just a few feet from Tameriz, which is his preference these days.
sentences.zh: 用魔术师的行话来说，观众的规模使得他们能够坐在距离塔马利斯仅几英尺远的地方，这是他如今最喜欢的安排。

sentences.en: Most of them joined him at the front at one point or another, and much of the magic seemed to be executed by them.
sentences.zh: 他们中的大多数人在某个时刻都加入了前排，而且许多魔术似乎都是由他们自己完成的。

sentences.en: As often as Tameriz had someone pick a card, any card, as standard operating procedure dictates, he had them simply name one or even just think of one.
sentences.zh: 正如标准的日常操作规定那样，塔马利斯不仅让别人选择一张牌——任何牌，他还让他们直接说出一张甚至仅仅在脑海里想一张牌。

sentences.en: At times, he guided spectators through a procedure that led to an impossible result, without appearing to touch the cards himself.
sentences.zh: 有时，他引导观众完成一套流程，从而导向一个不可思议的结果，而他自己似乎都没有碰过那些牌。

sentences.en: Two volunteers shuffled a deck and cut it into four piles.
sentences.zh: 两名志愿者洗了一副牌并将其切成四叠。

sentences.en: Without knowing it, they had found the four aces.
sentences.zh: 在不知不觉中，他们已经找出了四张A。

sentences.en: They each chose a card and replaced it in the deck, dividing it in half between themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们每人选择一张牌并将其放回牌堆中，由他们自己将牌对半平分。

sentences.en: Cutting again, each located the other's card.
sentences.zh: 再次切牌后，每个人都找出了对方的牌。

sentences.en: In the end, two spectators shuffled separate decks, both of which were then found to be in the exact same order, down to the last card.
sentences.zh: 最后，两名观众分别洗了两副牌，结果发现这两副牌的精确顺序完全一致，一直到最后一张牌。

sentences.en: The crowd gasped and squealed, and when each trick was over, those remaining craned their necks to catch the maestro's attention and be called up next.
sentences.zh: 人群倒吸了一口气并发出尖叫，每个戏法结束后，剩下的人都伸长脖子吸引大师的注意，以便被叫到下一个上台。

sentences.en: In the United States, the most visible performers of magic in the late 20th century were stage illusionists.
sentences.zh: 在美国，20世纪后期最显眼的魔术表演者是舞台幻术师。

sentences.en: Doug Henning,
sentences.zh: 道格·亨宁、

sentences.en: David Copperfield,
sentences.zh: 大卫·科波菲尔、

sentences.en: Siegfried and Roy, all of whom worked with big boxes and flashing lights.
sentences.zh: 齐格弗里德和罗伊，他们所有人都使用大箱子和闪烁的灯光进行表演。

sentences.en: The sort of magician, in other words, who might actually make someone's wife disappear.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，就是那种可能真的会让某个人的妻子消失的魔术师。

sentences.en: This put them as much in competition with Steven Spielberg and George Lucas as with their predecessors in magic.
sentences.zh: 这使得他们与史蒂芬·斯皮尔伯格和乔治·卢卡斯的竞争，不亚于他们与魔术界前辈们的竞争。

sentences.en: They were creators of spectacle, witnessed at a distance.
sentences.zh: 他们是奇观的创造者，是在远处被目睹的。

sentences.en: But Damaris appeared on stage and screen, armed with little more than his two hands.
sentences.zh: 但达马利斯出现在舞台和屏幕上时，手里几乎只有他的两只手。

sentences.en: Instead of relying on carefully engineered contraptions, he engineered the attention of his audience.
sentences.zh: 他没有依赖精心设计的机械装置，而是精心操控了观众的注意力。

sentences.en: He introduced Spanish viewers to the style of magic called close-up, done with ordinary objects, and near enough proximity for a conversation
sentences.zh: 他向西班牙观众引进了被称为近景的魔术风格，使用普通的物品，保持足以进行对话的近距离，

sentences.en: and incorporating the participation of spectators.
sentences.zh: 并且融合了观众的参与。

sentences.en: Damaris has performed on American television once, on a 1994 NBC special called
sentences.zh: 达马利斯曾在美国电视上表演过一次，那是在1994年全国广播公司的特别节目中，

sentences.en: The World's Greatest Magic.
sentences.zh: 名为《世界最伟大魔术》。

sentences.en: By then, he had mostly retired from Spanish television after regular appearances over the course of nearly 20 years.
sentences.zh: 到那时，在经历了近20年规律的电视出镜后，他已经基本从西班牙电视界退居幕后。

sentences.en: But he was introduced by the host as the world's greatest close-up magician, perhaps the greatest that ever lived.
sentences.zh: 但他被主持人介绍为世界上最伟大的近景魔术师，也许是有史以来最伟大的魔术师。

sentences.en: He was certainly nothing like the American archetype of a stage magician, producing doves in black tie and tails.
sentences.zh: 他绝对不像美国传统中身穿燕尾服、头戴礼帽变出鸽子的舞台魔术师那样。

sentences.en: Damaris sat at a small casino table wearing a purple top hat.
sentences.zh: 达马利斯坐在一个小赌场桌旁，头戴一顶紫色的礼帽。

sentences.en: Now I'm going to do a special trick,
sentences.zh: “现在我要做一个特别的戏法，”

sentences.en: Damaris screamed.
sentences.zh: 达马利斯大喊道。

sentences.en: He handed out a deck of cards, demanding, shuffle, shuffle, shuffle.
sentences.zh: 他分发了一副牌，并要求道：“洗牌，洗牌，洗牌。”

sentences.en: He picked up the table to show that there was nothing under it.
sentences.zh: 他拿起桌子向大家展示桌子底下什么也没有。

sentences.en: The spectators jumped at his abrupt shifts in volume.
sentences.zh: 观众们对他的音量突变感到吃惊。

sentences.en: The trick he did is called
sentences.zh: 他所做的戏法被称为

sentences.en: El Cochecito, and it is one of Damaris' signature pieces.
sentences.zh: 《小汽车》（El Cochecito），这是达马利斯的标志性作品之一。

sentences.en: In it, spectators are shown a toy car, the cochecito, and one is invited to choose a card from a deck.
sentences.zh: 在其中，观众们会看到一辆玩具小汽车（cochecito），其中一人被邀请从一副牌中选择一张牌。

sentences.en: The deck is shuffled and spread out on the table.
sentences.zh: 牌被洗好并摊开在桌子上。

sentences.en: Damaris then invites another spectator to push the cochecito along the length of the deck.
sentences.zh: 接着，达马利斯邀请另一位观众推着小汽车沿着牌堆的长度前行。

sentences.en: It eventually seems to hit a snag and stops in front of one card, resisting the spectator's hand.
sentences.zh: 它最终似乎遇到了阻碍并在某张牌前停了下来，抗拒着观众的手。

sentences.en: Damaris eliminates most of the cards, laying out those remaining in a different configuration, face down.
sentences.zh: 达马利斯排除了大部分牌，将剩下的牌以不同的牌面朝下的阵型摆开。

sentences.en: But no matter the path it travels, the cochecito still seems to stop at the same card.
